newsitem.title: USA: Brooklyn Union receives fuel cell grant.
newsitem.headline: Brooklyn Union receives fuel cell grant.

text.p: Brooklyn Union Gas Co said Tuesday it was awarded a U.S. Department of Energy grant for purchasing, installing and testing natural gas-powered fuel cells.
Brooklyn Union was one of the first 15 commercial purchasers to receive federal funding, the utility said.

The DOE awarded Brooklyn Union $400,000 for the purchase of two 200-kilowatt fuel cells, the company said. The cells, already in operation, supply electricity and thermal energy to the Sun Chemical Corp, a maker of cosmetic products, in Staten Island. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.
